notes.decision: Translated 'secrecy' from root ϫⲱⲡ/ⲭⲱⲡ 'be hidden, secret.' Paired here antithetically with ⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲁϣⲓⲡⲉ 'shame' as the two negative conditions of the Mind of Light when bound in the body.

Translated 'array/encampment' from Greek παρεμβολή (cf. accumulated vocabulary ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲏ, ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲟⲗⲁⲩⲉ). The orthography ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲙⲡⲧⲟⲗⲏ may reflect scribal variation or metathesis. Alternatively could be παράπτωμα 'transgression,' but the body-falls-at-his-encampment imagery fits the established Manichaean martial-cosmological register.

Translated 'snares' tentatively. ⲥⲉⲕ may be Lyc. variant of ⲥⲱⲕ 'draw, drag, pull' as nomen actionis = 'pulls/draggings/snares' of Sin. Alternative: a corruption of ⲛⲕⲟⲧⲕ 'sleep' (sleep of Sin = Manichaean motif). Etymology uncertain.

Read as 3pl impersonal forms with ϩ- onset (Lyc. for ⲥⲉ-): 'they constrain/scatter/set them.' The triple verbal sequence describes how the dark powers handle the bound reflections of the body. Alternative reading as qualitatives ('constrained, scattered, set') is also possible.
Translated 'surpassing even more abundantly': ⲟⲩⲁⲧⲃⲉ from ⲟⲩⲱⲧⲃ̄ 'pass over, exceed' + ⲉϩⲡⲍⲟⲩⲟ comparative 'unto the more.' Standard intensification idiom.

Translated 'is upon him' tentatively. ϩⲉⲓⲡⲉ is unidentified — possibly ϩⲉⲡ/ϩⲏⲡⲉ 'necessity, what is fixed,' or related to ϩⲓ-ⲡⲉ 'upon, over.' The general sense (something further weighs on him) fits context of describing additional impositions on the bound Mind.

Translated 'to defile' from ϫⲱϩⲙ̄/ϫⲱϩ 'pollute, defile.' Alternative reading as 'unto completion' (ⲁ + ϫⲱⲕ) is possible per accumulated vocabulary, but defilement of the elect by the false spirit fits Manichaean theology better here.
Per accumulated vocabulary, translated 'the Half' as cosmological designation of an intermediate region. Above 'all the works of the Half' = the realm beyond the manifest cosmos.
Translated 'they keep watch' — habitual ϣⲁⲩ + ⲣ̄- + ⲟⲩⲱⲣϩ. The root ⲟⲩⲱⲣϩ may be Lyc. for ⲱⲣϩ̄/ⲱⲣⲍ 'watch, guard, be settled.' Alternative: 'they are established/abide in.'
Translated 'his heart agrees': ⲡⲧⲱⲧ understood as 'persuaded, joined' from ⲧⲱⲧ 'agree, be joined,' here as predicate of ⲡⲉϩⲍⲏⲧ 'his heart' in habitual construction with ϣⲁⲣⲉ.
Translated 'itself/very' (intensive); per accumulated vocabulary ⲍⲱⲱϩ = ϩⲱⲱϥ 'himself/itself' as reflexive/intensive pronoun.

Translated 'the wonder.' The + symbol likely represents either ⲡ (article) giving ⲡϣⲡⲏⲣⲉ 'the wonder/marvel' or ϯ giving ϯ-ϣⲡⲏⲣⲉ 'I marvel/give wonder.' Read as articulated noun in object position of ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉⲧⲕ 'make known to you.'

Translated 'multitude' tentatively. The compound is unusual — possibly ⲙⲛⲧ- (abstract) + ⲗⲏⲙⲏϣⲉ/ⲣⲉⲙⲙⲏϣⲉ 'multitudinous person' = 'state-of-being-a-multitude.' Mani's 'multitude' would be his community/church. Alternative: 'manifoldness' or 'mass.'
Translated 'single shepherd' (μανϫϣⲱⲥ = ⲙⲁⲛⲉ-ⲉⲥⲟⲟⲩ 'shepherd of sheep'; ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ 'single, alone'). Mani's standard self-designation as the unique pastor of his church.
Translated 'silver' (Lyc. ⲍⲉⲧ = Sah. ϩⲁⲧ 'silver'), in standard metals enumeration with gold and bronze.

Translated 'violence' tentatively. May represent Greek βίας 'force, violence' with prosthetic ⲫ-, or be related to Coptic ⲑⲃⲓⲟ/ⲫⲃⲓⲟ 'humbling.' The contrast with line 31 ⲡⲟⲩⲫⲃⲓ̈ⲟ 'they did not subdue' suggests a coercive-force semantic field.
Translated 'they bind it' tentatively, from ⲙⲟⲩⲣ 'bind' with 3sg.f. suffix. The cosmos is 'bound' (subjugated) by means of favors and gifts. Alternative: μόρος 'fate' (Greek). Confidence low.
Translated 'they did not subdue' — negated perfect ⲙⲡⲟⲩ- + ⲫⲃⲓⲟ/ⲑⲃⲓⲟ 'humble, abase, subdue.' The kings of the cosmos with all their wealth and force did not actually conquer.
